description: This file defines a React component 'AvailabilityManager' for managing the availability schedules of doctors and ICU rooms. It includes API helper functions for CRUD operations, state management, form handling, inline editing, and rendering of the availability list with create, update, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Performs fetch requests to the API endpoints, handling JSON responses and errors.

methods.name: fetchDoctors
methods.description: Fetches the list of doctors from the API.

methods.name: fetchICUs
methods.description: Fetches the list of ICU rooms from the API.

methods.name: createAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Creates a new availability entry via POST request.

methods.name: updateAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Updates an existing availability entry via PUT request.

methods.name: deleteAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Deletes an availability entry via DELETE request.
